evals.name: check-reports-acting-account-and-provenance
evals.expected_output: Reports gh presence with the ACTING account and host, the context-guard seam state with the resulting dispatch mode, every config layer found, and the effective value of each key with the layer that supplied it; edits nothing.
expectations: Names the acting gh account explicitly, not just 'authenticated'
Reports dispatch mode as zone-informed or conservative based on the snapshot probe
Effective sink is reported with per-layer provenance (which layer supplied it)
Read-only: no file writes in check

evals.name: absent-gh-is-info-not-failure
evals.prompt:
/plugin-quality:setup check

gh is not installed on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Classifies missing gh as INFO — the sink ladder ends in the local markdown fallback, so audits still work — rather than a FAIL demanding installation.
expectations: Does not block or fail the check on missing gh
Names the local markdown fallback as the operative sink path
Still surfaces how to install gh for operators who want the issue sink

evals.name: apply-is-idempotent-and-scoped
evals.prompt:
/plugin-quality:setup apply sink=markdown-dir markdown_dir=~/audit-items

Run it twice.
evals.expected_output: First run writes/converges the tracked .claude/plugin-quality.md (only the named keys; other keys and prose preserved) and reports old->new; second run reports no diff. Recommends the recursive .claude/**/*.local.* gitignore line without touching .gitignore.
expectations: Second identical apply produces no content change and says so
Never writes the consumer's .gitignore; the overlay line is a surfaced recommendation
Never creates or edits the user-global or .local layers
